name: @pipeworx/mcp-jina-reader

tools.name: read_url
tools.description: Fetch any web page as clean, LLM-ready markdown (strips nav/ads) — ideal for giving an agent the readable content of a URL.

url.description: The full target URL to fetch, e.g. "https://example.com/article".

_apiKey.description: Your Jina API key. Required — Jina no longer serves anonymous requests. Pipeworx injects its own when one is configured; free keys at https://jina.ai/reader.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Web search returning the top results as markdown, via Jina. Needs a Jina API key (pass via _apiKey) — Jina stopped serving anonymous requests.

query.description: The search query, e.g. "best coffee in Seattle".

_apiKey.description: Your Jina API key. Required — Jina no longer serves anonymous requests. Pipeworx injects its own when one is configured; free keys at https://jina.ai/reader.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-jina-reader forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the jina-reader pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
